message.reasoning:
The user wants two tickets:

1) Musical theater "Mamma Mia!" on next Friday (the same day as the train). They want a ticket.

2) Train from New York to Chicago on the same day.

We need to call both functions with appropriate arguments.

But we don't know exact dates; but we can compute next Friday's date relative to current date? Current date is May 16, 2026. Next Friday would be May 18, 2026? Let's check: May 16, 2026 is Thursday. So next Friday is May 17, 2026. Wait let's confirm: If today is Thu 16th, then Fri 17th is tomorrow. But they said "next week Friday" maybe meaning upcoming Friday after this weekend? Usually "next Friday" could mean the coming Friday which might be within the same week or next week depending context. Since it's currently Thursday, I'd interpret it as the immediate next Friday, i.e., May 17, 2026. However if they'd say "下週五", Chinese phrase often means the Friday of the following week, not the immediate one. For example, if today is Monday, 下週五 refers to Friday of next week. But here it's Thursday, so "下週五" may refer to Friday of next week, which would be May 24, 2026. This nuance matters. In many contexts, "下周五" indeed means the Friday of the next calendar week, regardless of whether there's an earlier Friday soon. Because "本周" vs "下周". Today is Thursday, still part of this week. So "下週五" likely refers to the Friday of the next week, which will be May 24, 2026. That seems plausible.

Thus we set date=May 24, 2026.

Now we have to buy a musical theatre ticket for Mamma Mia! on that date. Use musical_ticket_buy(show="Mamma Mia!", date="2026-05-24").

Also purchase a train ticket from New York to Chicago on that date. Use train_ticket_buy(origin="New York", destination="Chicago", date="2026-05-24").

We'll produce calls accordingly.
